verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no benchmarks, documentation, or community reports on how Angular's build or type-check times scale in large multi-thousand-component codebases or monorepos. The persistent disk cache command and the generic "scale with the size of your team" marketing line are adjacent features that say nothing about build-time scaling. The community comments cover runtime binding performance and maintainability, not compile times.

support.subject: As a developer, I know how the framework's build and type-check times scale in large, multi-thousand-component codebases or monorepos
